# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.2 Worker 1: Imperial Road Office Auto-Builder effects (oe_road_).
# Generated by gen_v122_imperial_roads.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Ensures all persistent counters and config defaults are safely initialized before any change_variable.
oe_road_ensure_init = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_auto_enabled } } set_variable = { name = oe_road_auto_enabled value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_mode } } set_variable = { name = oe_road_mode value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_tier_policy } } set_variable = { name = oe_road_tier_policy value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_floor_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_road_floor_tier value = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_cap_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_road_cap_tier value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_life_segments } } set_variable = { name = oe_road_life_segments value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_yr_segments } } set_variable = { name = oe_road_yr_segments value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_cul2_segments } } set_variable = { name = oe_road_cul2_segments value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_road_stat_year }
				NOT = { var:oe_road_stat_year ?= current_year }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_road_stat_year value = current_year }
		set_variable = { name = oe_road_yr_segments value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Increments transparent telemetry counters only when a real construct_road is dispatched.
oe_road_record_segment_built = {
	change_variable = { name = oe_road_life_segments add = 1 }
	change_variable = { name = oe_road_yr_segments add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_road_from
			scope:oe_road_from = {
				exists = dominant_culture
				NOT = { dominant_culture ?= root.culture }
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_road_cul2_segments add = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Dispatches paid construct_road for (scope:oe_road_from -> scope:oe_road_to) using optimal road tier.
oe_road_dispatch_segment = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_road_from
			exists = scope:oe_road_to
			gold >= oe_road_safe_gold
			scope:oe_road_from = { has_road_constructions = no }
			scope:oe_road_to = { has_road_constructions = no }
		}
		# --- Policy 2: Economic Practical Coverage (gravel for rural, paved/imperial-L2 for towns/cities) ---
		if = {
			limit = { var:oe_road_tier_policy ?= 2 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:oe_road_from = {
						OR = {
							location_rank ?= location_rank:town
							location_rank ?= location_rank:city
							location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
						}
					}
					road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root }
				}
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:oe_road_from = {
						OR = {
							location_rank ?= location_rank:town
							location_rank ?= location_rank:city
							location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
						}
					}
					road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root }
				}
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:oe_road_from = {
						OR = {
							location_rank ?= location_rank:town
							location_rank ?= location_rank:city
							location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
						}
					}
					road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root }
				}
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:oe_road_from = {
						OR = {
							location_rank ?= location_rank:town
							location_rank ?= location_rank:city
							location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
						}
					}
					road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root }
				}
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:paved_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:gravel_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:gravel_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:paved_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:modern_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:railroad from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
		}
		# --- Policy 1 (Default): Strongest Unlocked Road (v9.6 imperial roads prioritized over same-level vanilla) ---
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:railroad from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:modern_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:paved_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { road_type:gravel_road = { is_available_for = root } }
				construct_road = { road_type = road_type:gravel_road from = scope:oe_road_from to = scope:oe_road_to }
				oe_road_record_segment_built = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Human-only O(N) monthly pulse entry point (called by Stage oe_v122_pulse.txt).
oe_road_monthly_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			is_rebel_country = no
			var:oe_road_auto_enabled ?= 1
			NOT = { oe_road_ogas_active = yes }
			NOT = { var:oe_road_ran_month ?= oe_road_month_now }
			oe_road_has_any_road_tech = yes
			gold >= oe_road_safe_gold
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_road_ran_month value = oe_road_month_now }
		oe_road_ensure_init = yes
		# Single O(N) pass capped at 2 / 5 / 10 highest-priority segments per month.
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_road_candidate_location = yes }
			order_by = oe_road_location_priority
			max = oe_road_pacing_cap
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_road_constructions = no
					root = { gold >= oe_road_safe_gold }
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_road_from
				ordered_neighbor_location = {
					limit = { oe_road_valid_anchor_neighbor = yes }
					order_by = oe_road_neighbor_anchor_score
					max = 1
					check_range_bounds = no
					save_scope_as = oe_road_to
					root = { oe_road_dispatch_segment = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Lightweight O(1)-gated annual AI road pulse (major powers >= 20 locs + Yuan frontier provinces YLB/YLY/YGU, max 2 segments/yr).
oe_road_ai_yearly_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_rebel_country = no
			at_war = no
			gold >= 400
			oe_road_has_any_road_tech = yes
			NOT = { oe_road_ogas_active = yes }
			OR = {
				num_locations >= 20
				tag = YLB
				tag = YLY
				tag = YGU
			}
		}
		oe_road_ensure_init = yes
		set_variable = { name = oe_road_floor_tier value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_road_tier_policy value = 2 }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_road_candidate_location = yes }
			order_by = oe_road_location_priority
			max = 2
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_road_constructions = no
					root = { gold >= 400 }
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_road_from
				ordered_neighbor_location = {
					limit = { oe_road_valid_anchor_neighbor = yes }
					order_by = oe_road_neighbor_anchor_score
					max = 1
					check_range_bounds = no
					save_scope_as = oe_road_to
					root = { oe_road_dispatch_segment = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Console Toggle / Cycle Helpers (called from oe_road.1 / .10 / .20 / .90) ---
oe_road_toggle_master = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	if = { limit = { var:oe_road_auto_enabled ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_road_auto_enabled value = 0 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = oe_road_auto_enabled value = 1 } }
}

oe_road_set_mode_1 = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_road_mode value = 1 }
}

oe_road_set_mode_2 = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_road_mode value = 2 }
}

oe_road_set_mode_3 = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_road_mode value = 3 }
}

oe_road_toggle_tier_policy = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	if = { limit = { var:oe_road_tier_policy ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_road_tier_policy value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = oe_road_tier_policy value = 2 } }
}

oe_road_cycle_floor = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	if = { limit = { var:oe_road_floor_tier ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_road_floor_tier value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:oe_road_floor_tier ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_road_floor_tier value = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:oe_road_floor_tier ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_road_floor_tier value = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:oe_road_floor_tier ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_road_floor_tier value = 5 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = oe_road_floor_tier value = 1 } }
}

oe_road_cycle_cap = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	if = { limit = { var:oe_road_cap_tier ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_road_cap_tier value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:oe_road_cap_tier ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_road_cap_tier value = 3 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = oe_road_cap_tier value = 1 } }
}

oe_road_reset_stats = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_road_life_segments value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_road_yr_segments value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_road_cul2_segments value = 0 }
}

# --- Page 93 Dev Panel Helpers (command-safe; NEVER writes OGAS_Auto_Build) ---
oe_road_dev_open_console = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_road.1
}

oe_road_dev_open_ledger = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_road.90
}

oe_road_dev_toggle_master = {
	oe_road_toggle_master = yes
}

oe_road_dev_set_mode_1 = {
	oe_road_set_mode_1 = yes
}

oe_road_dev_set_mode_2 = {
	oe_road_set_mode_2 = yes
}

oe_road_dev_set_mode_3 = {
	oe_road_set_mode_3 = yes
}

oe_road_dev_toggle_tier_policy = {
	oe_road_toggle_tier_policy = yes
}

oe_road_dev_cycle_floor = {
	oe_road_cycle_floor = yes
}

oe_road_dev_cycle_cap = {
	oe_road_cycle_cap = yes
}

oe_road_dev_step_build = {
	oe_road_ensure_init = yes
	add_gold = 3000
	set_variable = { name = oe_road_auto_enabled value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_road_ran_month value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = road_building } }
		research_advance = advance_type:road_building
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_advance = road_building
			NOT = { has_advance = paved_road_advance }
			NOT = { any_owned_location = { oe_road_candidate_location = yes } }
		}
		research_advance = advance_type:paved_road_advance
	}
	oe_road_monthly_tick = yes
}

oe_road_dev_grant_road_techs = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = road_building } }
		research_advance = advance_type:road_building
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = paved_road_advance } }
		research_advance = advance_type:paved_road_advance
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
				culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
			}
			NOT = { has_advance = oe_adv_via_imperialis }
		}
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_adv_via_imperialis
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = CHI
				tag = YUA
				tag = GLH
				tag = WHO
				tag = TIM
				has_or_had_tag = MNG
				culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
			}
			NOT = { has_advance = oe_adv_yam_post_road }
		}
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_adv_yam_post_road
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = MOS
				has_or_had_tag = RUS
				culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:russian_group }
			}
			NOT = { has_advance = oe_adv_siberian_trakt }
		}
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_adv_siberian_trakt
	}
}
